Instr shape moves to [16,16,16] for fp16. Env levers: VLLM_G128_PREFILL_GLUON_MMA, VLLM_G128_GLUON_MMA, VLLM_G128_DRAFT_GLUON_MMA (fp16 | bf16)

status: HEADROOM CONFIRMED: the packed-KV int8 loads compile to scalar global_load_ubyte (32 per kernel body) - the 1Cat PR #268 finding replicated on this stack
interpretation: Only 8 of ~67 global loads are 128-bit (likely the Q tiles); the K/V int8 tiles load one byte per instruction despite 8-contiguous size_per_thread layouts. Likely causes: the prefill core reuses q_layout (built for the [64,128] Q operand) for the [32,128] K/V tiles then permutes to dot operands, unlike the m64 decode core which defines a dedicated kv_layout; and/or alignment is not provable through the int64 pointer arithmetic. The fix direction is a dedicated kv_layout for K/V loads in the prefill core (mirroring m64) - a bounded kernel edit with the existing isolated bench as the gate. At 2.8s/15s prefill and ~4ms/step decode attention, a 1Cat-class 20-25% kernel gain is worth ~0.6s TTFT + ~1ms/step.
